'''''Metzgeria''''' is a [[genus]] of [[thalloid]] [[Marchantiophyta|liverworts]] in the [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] [[Metzgeriaceae]].<ref name="Schuster V">{{cite book | last = Schuster | first = Rudolf M. | year = 1992 | title = The Hepaticae and Anthocerotae of North America | volume=V | pages=665–752 | location=Chicago | publisher = Field Museum of Natural History | isbn = 0-914868-20-9 }}</ref>

==Taxonomy==
The genus was named in honor of [[Johann Metzger]] (1771–1844), a German copper engraver and art restorer from [[Staufen im Breisgau]], in [[Baden-Württemberg]], a friend of [[Giuseppe Raddi]] and pupil of the great Florentine engraver [[Raffaello Sanzio Morghen]] (1753–1833).<ref>K. Danz 2003. ''‘Florenz ist die Schazkammer von klassischen Gemälden’. Der Florentiner Kunstmarkt im beginnenden 19. Jahrundert und die Gemäldesammlung Ludwigs I. von Bayern''. PhD thesis, Albert-Ludwigs-Universität, Freiburg.</ref>

===Species===
Species may be either [[monoicous]] or [[monoicous|dioicous]].
